371:t_1:172.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Yeah... My name's $$ティティ$$. What's yours?」

371:t_1:174.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Do you live in the camp too, $f? I've never seen you before...」

371:t_1:175.en:
$n
「Not quite. I came here to volunteer.」

371:t_1:177.en:
$n
「It means working for others out of a desire to help.」

371:t_1:179.en:
$n
「...I don't know. I enjoy it well enough.」

371:t_1:180.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Then I want you to teach me too, if you think it's fun, $f.」

371:t_1:183.en:
$n
「It's not that. You asked so suddenly, it caught me a little off guard.」

371:t_1:184.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Aren't surprises like that fun?」

371:t_1:185.en:
$n
「...You're cheerful. You must be in a rough situation, living in the camp.」

371:t_1:186.en:
$$ティティ$$
「The camp, huh...? There's been some weird guy there since about yesterday...」

371:t_1:189.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Um... I think that's an emergency alarm...」

371:t_1:190.en:
$n
「Get to safety, $$ティティ$$! This place is about to become a battlefield!」

371:t_2:3.en:
$$香月$$
「What the hell are you saying!? The $$神ファミリー$$ is fighting for us!」

371:t_2:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You children don't understand a thing...!」

371:t_2:6.en:
$$香月$$
「You're the one who doesn't understand!」

371:t_2:9.en:
$$ミチ$$
「We heard some strange man was making a scene over there, and when we came, he was saying things like that...」

371:t_2:11.en:
$$香月$$
「The $$神ファミリー$$... $$勝平$$... They're risking their lives to protect us!」

371:t_2:12.en:
$$ギルター$$
「That $$ガイゾック$$ attacked in the first place because they're descendants of the $$ビアル星人$$, didn't it?」

371:t_2:13.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I'm sure $$サイデリアル$$ is the same.」

371:t_2:14.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Is that so...? Then why is $$サイデリアル$$ building those things called $$レイライン$$s?」

371:t_2:16.en:
$$香月$$
「Everyone, remember! Remember what we did to the $$神ファミリー$$!」

371:t_2:18.en:
$$香月$$
「We were just like him... We decided the $$神ファミリー$$ were the villains and hurled filthy insults at them, just like he's doing...」

371:t_2:19.en:
$$アキ$$
「But $$勝平$$ and the others fought for us! To protect us and Earth!」

371:t_2:20.en:
$$ミチ$$
「Everyone here should know what kind of people the $$神ファミリー$$ are!」

371:t_2:21.en:
$$香月$$
「Remember! We all apologized to $$勝平$$ and the others! What did he and $$兵左衛門$$ say then!?」

371:t_2:22.en:
$$香月$$
「Everyone makes mistakes... They didn't hold the past against us... That's how they forgave us!」

371:t_2:23.en:
$$アキ$$
「Are you still going to do the same thing again!? Are you going to doubt $$勝平$$ and the others!?」

371:t_2:24.en:
$$ミチ$$
「We can't do that...! It's... It's just too cruel to $$勝平$$!」

371:t_2:26.en:
$$市民$$
「Back then, I was ashamed of myself. I thanked the $$神ファミリー$$ without a hint of shame after persecuting them so much...」

371:t_2:27.en:
$$市民$$
「I thought I'd sworn then... that I'd believe in them no matter what...」

371:t_2:28.en:
$$市民$$
「You can do it, $$神ファミリー$$!」

371:t_2:29.en:
$$市民$$
「You can do it, $$ザンボット３$$!」

371:t_2:31.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Shouldn't you run away? You're the one who's going to get beaten to a pulp next.」

371:t_3:4.en:
$$葵$$
「...Are you sure, $$勝平$$? Didn't you want to see your friends more and have your mom spoil you a little?」

371:t_3:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「Knowing $$香月$$ and the others, and Mom and everyone, are doing well is enough for me.」

371:t_3:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「And once the fighting's over, I can see them again.」

371:t_3:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「Have you fallen for me, Sis $$葵$$?」

371:t_3:11.en:
$$葵$$
「You're about five... maybe ten years too young to talk like that.」

371:t_3:12.en:
$$勝平$$
「Tch...! So you're treating me like a kid after all.」

371:t_3:13.en:
$$万丈$$
「Don't sulk, $$勝平$$. You'll be an adult soon enough.」

371:t_3:14.en:
$$勝平$$
「You said soon...? When will that be?」

371:t_3:15.en:
$$万丈$$
「Hmm... In about five... ten years, perhaps.」

371:t_3:16.en:
$$勝平$$
「That's no different from what Sis $$葵$$ said!」

371:t_3:17.en:
$$くらら$$
「It seems we're all in agreement.」

371:t_3:18.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Don't worry about it, $$勝平$$. Life's easier when you're a kid.」

371:t_3:19.en:
$$勝平$$
「Talking like that is what got you homeless.」

371:t_3:20.en:
$$朔哉$$
「That's fine! I was living without a home because I wanted to!」

371:t_3:21.en:
$$勝平$$
「I don't want that. I want a huge mansion with a pool, a cool car, lots of beautiful women, and a butler...」

371:t_3:22.en:
$$勝平$$
「I'm aiming to be like Big Bro $$万丈$$!」

371:t_3:23.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Dreaming about things like that proves you're still a child.」

371:t_3:25.en:
$$勝平$$
「So you ARE treating me like a kid...!」

371:t_3:26.en:
$$葵$$
(But you're fortunate, $$勝平$$. You have family, and you have friends...)

371:t_3:27.en:
$$万丈$$
(And you're growing up, step by step. You're already a warrior in your own right.)

371:t_3:28.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「Then shall we... have those ohagi rice cakes $$勝平$$'s grandmother packed for us?」

371:t_3:30.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Don't be greedy, $$トッポ$$. I'll make some tea now.」

371:t_3:31.en:
$$トッポ$$
「But after all that, we ended up leaving Japan right after volunteering, and I barely got anything to eat!」
